title: Envato Launches Burst Mode Offering 6 AI Images for 1 Credit
summary:
Envato has released Burst mode for its AI image generator, which allows users to produce up to six distinct image directions from a single prompt or reference image. The feature operates up to 10x faster than prior tools and consumes only one AI credit for the entire set of images. Users can compare these results side by side and refine them using moodboards, a creativity control that ranges from focused to wild, and specific tools to vary or polish the selected output.

The increase in output per credit reflects a trend where falling AI inference costs are reducing the price of generation for the end user. This shift suggests that value in the AI sector is migrating toward platforms that own the proprietary data and the creative workflow used to manage compute demand.

ENVATO LAUNCHES BURST MODE: UP TO 6 AI IMAGE CONCEPTS FOR 1 CREDIT

The new feature enables up to 10x faster visual exploration inside its AI image generator.

Users can start with an idea or reference image, compare results side by side and guide them with moodboards, style settings and creativity controls.

“Vary” explores a different direction, “More like this” generates similar alternatives, and “Polish” refines the selected image.
